info.title: ARC Cloud API
info.description: Multi-tenant IoT platform API. Authenticate with `Authorization: Bearer <token>`: a user token from /api/v1/auth/login or /api/v1/auth/google, an organization API key (arc_sk_…), or a service-account token from /api/v1/oauth/token. Device endpoints (/update, /controls, /commands/next) use the device key in `api_key`. Errors are JSON with a stable `code`. Lists take `limit` (max 200) and `offset`.
